what: Give `local_pipeline_stub` a record mode and a strict replay mode for LLM calls, record the production model's real replies once, and run the audio, orchestrator-pipeline, context-suggestion and summarizer/evaluator integration tests in every gate run from those recordings; provider-behavior tests stay live and opt-in (gh #60).
why: Design: docs/work/recorded-llm-tests/design.md. Four daemon test files skip unless a live LLM is configured, so CI and `.specify/verify.sh` never check prompt building, reply parsing or storage on those paths. The suite already stands in for the LLM with `local_pipeline_stub`; recordings make that stand-in answer with what the production model (openai/gpt-5.4-nano via OpenRouter) really said.

criteria.given: a test that opts into recordings, with its recording file present and matching
criteria.then: it fails if any request leaves for a provider or the reply served is not the recorded one; otherwise the stub serves the recorded replies in call order and the test passes

criteria.given: a recording whose stored request differs from the live request in prompt text, and a test whose recording file is missing
criteria.then: it fails if either passes, skips, or falls back to the canned reply; otherwise each fails with a message naming the recording file and the PRISMIS_RECORD_LLM command to re-record

criteria.given: a recording whose request differs from the live request only in an ISO date, a 'Month D, YYYY' date or the model name
criteria.then: it fails if the replay is refused; otherwise the recorded reply is served

criteria.given: PRISMIS_RECORD_LLM naming a service in the operator's real llm-core services.toml and PRISMIS_RECORD_MODEL
criteria.when: a test runs in record mode
criteria.then: it fails if nothing is written or the reply is not the provider's; otherwise the request goes to that service with that model and the request, the real reply and the model are written to the test's recording file in call order

criteria.given: test_audio_api_integration.py `test_audio_generates_with_high_priority`, test_daemon_integration.py `test_daemon_orchestration_with_test_database`, the two live tests in test_context_api.py and the four in test_summarizer_evaluator_integration.py
criteria.when: the daemon test suite runs with no LLM credential
criteria.then: it fails if any of them is skipped or reaches the network; otherwise all run from committed recordings made with openai/gpt-5.4-nano, keep their existing assertions, and the pipeline test reads its feed from the stub's /feed.xml

criteria.when: the suite runs without PRISMIS_LIVE_LLM_TESTS and a reader looks up how LLM-backed tests run
criteria.then: it fails if the live provider tests run without the opt-in or the doc omits the record command; otherwise they still skip without it and boundaries.md states that LLM-backed integration tests replay recorded real replies and how to re-record them
it fails on any failing check; otherwise its last line is `verify: PASS`

outOfScope: A prompt edit to one of these paths requires re-recording its tests, about a dozen light calls, before the gate passes.
Replays prove prismis handles one real reply per call, not that the model will keep answering the same way.
Recording needs a machine with real llm-core credentials; CI only replays.
stakes: Every test that today skips for want of a live LLM, except the provider-behavior tests, runs in the gate.
Replays use replies the production model actually returned, recorded once and committed.
A replay makes no network call; a missing or outdated recording fails the test with the command to re-record, never skips or falls back.
Dates and the model name are the only request text a replay ignores.
No new dependency; the existing local stub does the recording and replaying.
Provider-behavior tests stay live and opt-in.
